name: Demo: technology adoption in small firms (synthetic)
case_description: Synthetic data for exploring the tool. Sixty small firms are described by managerial trust in the vendor, support from top management, available resources, and the degree to which a new system was adopted. By construction there are two routes to high adoption: trust together with management support, or ample resources in firms that do not rely on the vendor (low trust).

variables.name: TRUST
variables.construct_definition: Managerial trust in the technology vendor.
variables.instrument: Mean of four 7-point Likert items (1 = strongly disagree, 7 = strongly agree).

variables.name: SUPPORT
variables.construct_definition: Perceived top-management support for the system.
variables.instrument: Mean of three 7-point Likert items (1 = strongly disagree, 7 = strongly agree).

variables.name: RESOURCES
variables.instrument: Composite index of budget, staff time and training capacity, scaled 0-100.

variables.name: ADOPTION
variables.construct_definition: Extent to which the system is used in daily operations.
